text:
jessica_cs: Morning — FYI Crestline renewal in ~6w. Saw prod API calls drop ~82% since last Monday. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood.internal/crestline. Anyone seen outages or an internal change?
metrics-bot: [Alert] crestline-prod API requests down 82% (7d window). Top endpoints: /generate, /embed. No 5xx spike, token consumption down.
laura_csm: I pinged their PM (Theo) yesterday — he confirmed they're running a vendor eval pilot this month.
nate_sales: They mentioned Nimbus AI on the call. I flagged a competitive pilot in SFDC last week. @jessica_cs can you confirm if the drop is seat-level or API-key level?
jessica_cs: Quick query I ran:
```
SELECT date, count(*) FROM usage.events
WHERE account='crestline' AND env='prod'
GROUP BY date ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 14;
```
Results show sharp drop on 2026-03-10. No error spike in our logs; latency/cpu metrics look normal.
mina_eng: Checked infra — no deploys or infra regressions around 2026-03-10. KV cache hit rate steady. Nothing on our side.
oliver_se: Client-side change: they flipped an internal routing config during integration and started routing embeddings to a local endpoint last Thursday. I captured screenshots in the support ticket.
jessica_cs: So signal = usage migration + active competitor trial. What's our playbook for renewal-risk triage here? My initial thoughts: 1) schedule 1:1 with their new ML lead, 2) offer time-limited dedicated trial credit, 3) send concise ROI + cost comparison.
nate_sales: Sales prefers a 6-week dedicated trial credit + joint tech session to showcase latency/cost controls. @mina_eng is ENG available for a joint deep-dive next Tue?
mina_eng: We can do a 45m technical deep dive Tue 10:00 AM PT. Will cover latency profiles, quantization tips, batching knobs, and cost controls. I'll prep a short runbook.
laura_csm: I'll set the 1:1 with Theo and include sales + eng. Need to confirm decision timeline — likely end of quarter from procurement signals.
jessica_cs: Capture feedback: they called out token cost and predictable latency as reasons to eval Nimbus. I'll prepare a 1-pager cost comparison and a note on routing/fallback/resilience.
oliver_se: Can someone pull per-route 30d latency + cost for Crestline? @metrics-bot can you queue that report and upload to /shared/reports?
metrics-bot: Report queued: crestline-per-route-30d.csv uploaded to /shared/reports/crestline-per-route-30d.csv
nate_sales: Good. I'll draft the credit offer language and tie it to a joint tech session. If they insist on a pilot with Nimbus, propose an A/B where we run their heavier-weight path on our dedicated endpoints.
jessica_cs: Action items: Laura — schedule meeting; Mina — prepare tech deck & runbook; Oliver — attach config evidence to ticket; Nate — draft credit offer; Jessica — prepare cost comps & internal renewal risk note. :+1:
laura_csm: Invite sent to Theo for Tue 10:00 AM PT, added agenda + pre-reads (incl. cost comp draft).
jessica_cs: Thanks — keep thread updated. If usage continues to drop before the meeting we may proactively pause billing on affected keys until we clarify migration path (flagging finance).
finance-bot: Notice: billing hold requires formal approval. @emma_finance to review request.
emma_finance: Ack — I can review. We only approve holds for disputed charges or confirmed migrations; coordinate with ops for scope.
jessica_cs: Noted. Will open a formal hold request only if they ask for relief. Updating renewal risk to "high" until after the joint session.
laura_csm: Will follow up with Theo on timeline and confirm if they want vendor comparison details ahead of the meeting.
jessica_cs: Thanks all — reconvene after the session.
